tldr_zh: OpenAI加強AI安全防護與民主監督；Meta社群成癮訴訟開審；Cursor推出GitHub競品代管平台。
tldr_en: OpenAI strengthens AI security safeguards post-Hugging Face breach; Meta faces social media addiction lawsuit; Cursor launches GitHub rival platform.

items.title_zh: OpenAI加強前沿AI模型安全防護，提高開發審慎度
items.title_en: OpenAI Strengthens Safeguards for Frontier AI Models After Security Concerns
items.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布針對具有網路關鍵能力的前沿AI模型，強化監控、對齊和安全措施。該公司已暫停Astra模型開發，認為其具有「關鍵」網路安全能力，並在七月事件後實施新的研究環境改進和對齊技術，以控制模型開發進度。
items.summary_en: OpenAI announces strengthened monitoring, alignment, and security measures for frontier AI models with cyber-critical capabilities. The company has paused Astra model development and implemented new safeguards following July's Hugging Face incident.

items.title_zh: OpenAI推ChatGPT青少年版，內建強化保護機制與家長控制
items.title_en: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT for Teens with Enhanced Protections
items.summary_zh: OpenAI推出ChatGPT青少年版，針對年輕用戶設計，具有強化的內建保護、健康使用功能和家長額外控制選項，幫助青少年學習、批判性思考並自信地使用AI。
items.summary_en: OpenAI introduces ChatGPT for Teens with stronger built-in protections, health-use features, and parental controls to help teens learn and use AI responsibly.

items.title_zh: OpenAI推進國家安全民主監督，提供政府機構工具與培訓
items.title_en: OpenAI Launches Initiative for Democratic Oversight of AI in National Security
items.summary_zh: OpenAI啟動民主監督AI在國家安全領域應用的倡議，為政府機構提供工具、培訓和專業知識，加強AI在國防和安全領域的透明度與民主管制。
items.summary_en: OpenAI launches an initiative supporting government institutions with tools, training, and expertise to strengthen democratic oversight of AI in national security applications.

items.title_zh: Cursor推出代管平台Origin，直接對抗GitHub市場地位
items.title_en: Cursor Launches Code Hosting Platform Origin to Rival GitHub
items.summary_zh: AI程式碼編輯器Cursor推出代管平台Origin，向付費用戶開放早期測試。開發者可在Cursor平台內建立、保存程式庫、審查程式碼變更或同步GitHub專案，整合Vercel、Depot與Buildkite完整開發流程。
items.summary_en: Cursor launches Origin code hosting platform to rival GitHub, allowing developers to create, manage, and sync repositories directly within Cursor while integrating deployment and CI/CD tools.

items.title_zh: Apple重組歐盟App Store規則，簡化費用結構化解監管爭議
items.title_en: Apple Overhauls EU App Store Fees to Resolve Commission Disputes
items.summary_zh: Apple針對歐盟重新調整App Store規則，將所有開發者統一至單一商業條款，對App Store外流通應用徵收5%佣金替代按裝置計費，並放寬替代應用市集營運限制，以化解與歐盟委員會的分歧。
items.summary_en: Apple simplifies EU App Store terms with unified business rules, replacing per-install fees with 5% commission for third-party distribution and loosening alternative marketplace restrictions.

items.title_zh: Etched估值一月內翻倍至210億美元，Jane Street追投芯片系統
items.title_en: Etched's Valuation Doubles to $21B in One Month
items.summary_zh: AI晶片新創Etched在一個月內估值翻倍至210億美元。投資銀行Jane Street對其首套部署的AI叢集系統印象深刻，領導新一輪大規模融資，顯示AI硬體需求強勁。
items.summary_en: AI chip startup Etched's valuation doubles to $21B as Jane Street leads another massive funding round after deploying Etched's AI cluster system.

items.title_zh: Amazon據悉拆卸珍本書籍提取AI訓練資料，引發版權隱憂
items.title_en: Amazon Reportedly Dismantles Rare Books for AI Training Data
items.summary_zh: 據調查報導，Amazon購買大量珍本書籍後將其拆卸掃描作為AI模型訓練資料。404 Media透過追蹤裝置確認書籍運往Amazon拉斯維加斯物流中心VGT3。此舉引發對版權與內容來源倫理的質疑。
items.summary_en: Investigative report reveals Amazon dismantles rare books purchased for scanning to generate AI training data, raising copyright and ethical concerns about content sourcing.

items.title_zh: Meta在社群成癮訴訟開審，為美國多州集體訴訟應訴
items.title_en: Meta Faces Social Media Addiction Lawsuit as Trial Begins
items.summary_zh: 美國多州對Meta集體訴訟的審判已正式開始。Meta否認社群媒體成癮現象存在，但原告家庭認為該公司故意在Facebook與Instagram上設計成癮機制，傷害未成年人心理健康。
items.summary_en: Trial begins in major lawsuit where US states allege Meta deliberately designed Facebook and Instagram to addict users, particularly minors, despite company's denial that social media addiction exists.

items.title_zh: 美國對國際刑事法院領導人實施制裁，升級與ICC衝突
items.title_en: US Imposes Sanctions on ICC President and Senior Prosecutor
items.summary_zh: 川普政府對國際刑事法院（ICC）主席和資深檢察官實施新制裁。美方誓言要「一磚一瓦地拆解」ICC，此舉升級了美國與國際刑事法院的長期對立。
items.summary_en: Trump administration sanctions ICC president and senior prosecutor, escalating commitment to dismantle the international court that has issued arrest warrants affecting US allies.

items.title_zh: 烏克蘭深入俄境攻擊，英國堅定表態百分百支持基輔
items.title_en: UK Reaffirms Unwavering Support for Ukraine Amid Russian Threats
items.summary_zh: 烏克蘭今年加強對俄境內深入打擊，並使用英製無人機參戰，俄方揚言報復。英國首相柏南表示，英國將持續「百分之百」支持烏克蘭，雙方關係非勢利之交。
items.summary_en: UK Prime Minister reaffirms 100% support for Ukraine as Russia threatens retaliation over British-made drones used in deep strikes inside Russian territory.

items.title_zh: 辛巴威渡輪翻覆已94死，實際載客數為警方公布的兩倍
items.title_en: Zimbabwe Ferry Disaster Death Toll Rises to 94, Vessel Overloaded
items.summary_zh: 辛巴威卡瑞巴湖渡輪翻覆事件死亡人數升至94人。政府揭露該船實際載客約180人，為警方先前公布數字的兩倍，反映嚴重超載問題。
items.summary_en: Death toll from Zimbabwe ferry capsizing on Lake Kariba rises to 94; government reveals vessel carried approximately 180 passengers, double the initially reported capacity.

items.title_zh: 前佛奇顧問認罪隱匿新冠研究記錄，面臨監禁處罰
items.title_en: Ex-Fauci Adviser Pleads Guilty to Concealing COVID Research Records
items.summary_zh: 前美國首席醫療顧問佛奇的前任顧問認罪，承認在疫情期間策劃隱匿新冠疫情研究記錄。此案涉及政府研究誠信問題，引發對疫情期間科學透明度的關注。
items.summary_en: Ex-Fauci adviser pleads guilty to plotting to conceal COVID-19 research records during the pandemic, raising questions about scientific transparency during the health crisis.
